About This Property

Approximately 8.87 acres of land located in Norco, California, offering General Commercial (C-2) zoning. The property is adjacent to Neil Snipes Park and positioned along Hamner Avenue with convenient access to Interstate 15. This location provides strong visibility and connectivity to surrounding commercial activity and city development areas.Norco is recognized for its equestrian-oriented community, extensive trail system, and significant parkland. The surrounding environment reflects the city’s established rural and equestrian character.Zoning allows for a range of commercial uses, including retail, office, entertainment, or mixed commercial development, subject to city approval. Utilities are available, supporting future development planning.The property is situated near schools, community amenities, and major transportation routes. As the city continues to evolve, this parcel offers a strategic location for a variety of commercial uses consistent with local zoning and planning guidelines.All information is deemed reliable but not guaranteed.
